status: Prepared amendment; model identity, team agreement and workbook entry must be recorded before inference
unit: labelled Java comment occurrence at its supplied file and line range
id_policy: No author case ID exists. Assign dataset:000001 etc to ALL occurrences in the supplied JSON project/file/comment traversal order, before eligibility filtering. These are source-position IDs, not chronological dates.
eligibility: Java file; nonempty comment; a supported label; valid inclusive line range in the decoded supplied source
deduplication: None: different source locations are distinct occurrences; repeated text is reported as a limitation
execution_route: One recorded model, five independent fresh conversations of ten cases; no reference labels supplied
model: Record exact chosen model/display name in run_record.json before inference
temperature_policy: Record actual setting; use not_exposed if the interface does not expose it. Do not claim a seed or temperature was controlled when it was not.
primary_metric: Macro F1 over the fixed ten-label vocabulary; zero division gives 0
baseline: Always predict Not a smell for the same frozen cases
bounded_check: With complete provenance and 50 valid labels, macro F1 strictly above the fixed baseline supports the bounded capability check; at or below does not. This is descriptive, not a significance test or numerical reproduction of the full paper.
paper_reproduction_rule: Full-paper numerical equivalence remains inconclusive: different bounded sample, context, batching, current model and one run. Do not use the earlier RF 0.69/0.44 bands.
invalid_policy: Unknown label strings count as INVALID_OUTPUT and as errors; no case is dropped. Missing/duplicate IDs or unparseable responses stop scoring until documented recovery; never silently regenerate or select a preferred answer.
repair_selection: First ten cases with a valid predicted label other than Not a smell, in frozen sample order. Keep false positives as no-change candidates. If fewer than ten, retain all and report the shortfall.
repair_acceptance: Compare no change, comment-only repair and refactoring. Check the pinned current source, comment correctness, clarity, and behaviour evidence; unresolved mapping/build/test failures remain unverified.
evolution_policy: Preserve baseline labels/predictions. For traceably matched cases in a later pinned revision, independently review current labels before obtaining predictions with the unchanged prompt. Report paired errors and missing/changed cases separately. Do not treat missing cases as correct detections.
